review_description: It was easy to be lured into believing the promises made by Supa Solar. It was very, very disappointing after installation.As is industry practice, a spotters fee was promised for every referral. Three referrals were made and installations completed. Multiple promises to pay the spotters fee have not been completed. Trust has evaporated!Multiple tripping of the circuit breakers has occurred over several months. Details have been provided in writing. No response despite warranty obligations.Multiple emails and phone calls have not been answered. Raises the question "is the business still in business?" or "is the business teetering?"It's time to seek an early SolarVic audit to check if I have a lemon or maybe just a bad experience with this supplier

I only needed a small system, so i was only interested in price and lead in time. They delivered on both accounts. I read a few reviews which were hit and miss, so I was sceptical at first, but i am pleased with the end result. I wasn't eligible for state rebate.
